summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K, a report of a foreign private issuer, for the month of June 2026. The filing appears to be a routine periodic report containing no substantive disclosure of a special situation event. It includes only administrative information, a signature by the Director of Investor Relations, and an embedded image graphic. There are no terms, transactions, or events suggesting an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a standard current report with no special-situation content.
